title: The Wrong Revenue Report
description: Finance sees cent-level discrepancies and orders booked to the wrong day around month-end and DST.
objective: Reproduce the reported failures and repair the implementation without changing its public interfaces.
expectedBehavior: Order.created_at is UTC epoch seconds. Use the supplied read-only local_day helper for timezone conversion, including DST; it supports UTC and America/Los_Angeles for this exercise. Money uses long double input and integer cents; half-up round each discounted order before aggregation. Refund amounts are already dollars. Include zero-total input days. This port narrows the Python IANA timezone interface to the supplied helper's two documented zones.
constraints: Use the C++17 standard library and supplied read-only helpers only.
Do not change read-only files or tests.
